correctness.rationale: A binary LSD-first addition state consists of (carry,u,v) with carry∈{0,1} and u,v∈Z/3Z. For each proposed target bit, the transition enumerates all addend digits with the indicated outgoing carry and updates popcount residues. Starting at zero and accepting (0,c,c) is exactly the two-summand property; tracking target popcount supplies the one-summand alternative. The source NFA independently represents the finite lists and geometric repunit/3×power families. A breadth-first search over the finite reachable product of subset states is exhaustive over all finite canonical binary expansions; our separate implementation recovered exactly 108,108,107 reachable states with no comparison mismatch, and directly checked 8193 integers. This is a genuine infinite regular-language equivalence certificate, not extrapolation from a finite integer cutoff. The log-count coefficients follow from residue-class exponents and finite-overlap properties.
